items.difficulty_reason: H2: the author verifies both obstructions required by the general differential-transcendence criterion for these particular elliptic coefficients. Beyond the full source-local Riccati/divisor argument, the new step lifts a hypothetical constant-coefficient telescoper to an arbitrary finite elliptic cover, uses the finite pole-orbit structure of sigma(g)-g, and descends to an explicitly isolated zero/pole orbit of b. The exact A/B multiplicative relation lattices exclude all cancellations and orbit coincidences. The complete prior field-valued Galois criterion is supplied by old2040, without treating that nonroutine core as a standard prerequisite.
